skill.label: インテリア：空間分類とゾーニング

derivationRule: Use only the explicit p.105 three-zone classification by principal life activity: public zone = shared by family and visitors/many people; private zone = used by a specific individual; service zone = functional housework and wet/water-use spaces. Do not infer from floor-plan geometry, photographs, RGB/HEX, room colors, or unrelated four-zone taxonomies.

questions.prompt: 家族や来客を含め、多くの人がともに利用する空間はどのゾーンですか。

questions.explanation: 家族や来客を含め多くの人が利用する空間はパブリックゾーンです。
